SELECT IFNULL(SUM(IF(age IS NULL,1,0)),0) as unknownNum,IFNULL(ROUND((SUM(IF(age IS NULL,1,0))/COUNT(1)) *100),0) as unknownRate,IFNULL(SUM(IF(age<20,1,0)),0) as lessTwenty,IFNULL(SUM(IF(age>=20 and age<=30,1,0)),0) as twentyToThirty, IFNULL(SUM(IF(age>=31 and age<=40,1,0)),0) as thirtyToForty,IFNULL(SUM(IF(age>=41 and age<=50,1,0)),0) as fortyToFifty, IFNULL(SUM(IF(age>50,1,0)),0) as moreFifty,IFNULL(ROUND((SUM(IF(age<20,1,0))/COUNT(1)) *100),0) as lessTwentyRate, IFNULL(ROUND((SUM(IF(age>=20 and age<=30,1,0))/COUNT(1)) *100),0) as twentyToThirtyRate, IFNULL(ROUND((SUM(IF(age>=31 and age<=40,1,0))/COUNT(1)) *100),0) as thirtyToFortyRate, IFNULL(ROUND((SUM(IF(age>=41 and age<=50,1,0))/COUNT(1)) *100),0) as fortyToFiftyRate, IFNULL(ROUND((SUM(IF(age>50,1,0))/COUNT(1)) *100),0) as moreFiftyRate FROM( SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(keeper_id_card_number, 7, 8), '%Y%m%d'), CURDATE()) AS age FROM bm_gridkeeper dataTable

SELECT CAST(b.gridId AS CHAR) as gridId,b.gridName,b.gridLevel,SUM(b.clockInNum) as clockInNum,SUM(b.workDay) as workDay ,IF(SUM(b.workDay) = 0 OR SUM(b.workDay) IS NULL,NULL,IFNULL(ROUND((SUM(b.clockInNum)/SUM(b.workDay)) *100),0)) AS attendanceRate, IFNULL((SUM(b.clockInNum)/SUM(b.workDay) *100),0) AS attendanceRates, SUM(b.inNum) as inNum,SUM(b.lateNum) as lateNum,SUM(b.noInNum) as noInNum, SUM(b.outNum) as outNum,SUM(b.earlyNum) as earlyNum,SUM(b.noOutNum) as noOutNum FROM( SELECT dataTable.grid_id AS gridId, g.keeper_id as keeperId, dataTable.grid_name AS gridName, dataTable.grid_level AS gridLevel, COUNT(g.attendance_id) as workDay, SUM(IF(g.sign_in_status ='1' OR g.sign_in_status = '2' OR g.sign_out_status ='4' OR g.sign_out_status = '5',1,0)) AS clockInNum, SUM(IF(g.sign_in_status ='1',1,0)) as inNum,SUM(IF(g.sign_in_status ='2',1,0)) as lateNum,SUM(IF(g.sign_in_status ='3'OR ((g.sign_in_status is null or g.sign_in_status = '7') and DATE_FORMAT( g.attendance_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d' )AND DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%H:%i:%s' )> DATE_FORMAT( s.sign_over, '%H:%i:%s' )),1,0)) as noInNum, SUM(IF(g.sign_out_status ='4',1,0)) as outNum,SUM(IF(g.sign_out_status ='5',1,0)) as earlyNum,SUM(IF(g.sign_out_status ='6'OR ((g.sign_out_status is null) and DATE_FORMAT( g.attendance_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d' ) AND DATE_FORMAT( NOW(), '%H:%i:%s' )> DATE_FORMAT( s.sign_close, '%H:%i:%s' )),1,0)) as noOutNum FROM bm_grid dataTable LEFT JOIN bm_attendance_set s ON s.tenant_id = dataTable.tenant_id and s.industry_code = dataTable.industry_code and s.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_grid_keeper_ref r ON dataTable.grid_id = r.grid_id and r.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_gridkeeper k ON k.keeper_id = r.keeper_id and k.delete_flag=0 AND k.status=0 LEFT JOIN bm_attendance_line g ON k.keeper_id = g.keeper_id and r.grid_id = g.grid_id and g.delete_flag = 0 and g.keeper_id is not null
